title: A Layer-wise Analysis of Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2604.11838v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While critical for alignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) incurs the risk of catastrophic forgetting, yet the layer-wise emergence of instruction-following capabilities remains elusive. We investigate this mechanism via a comprehensive analysis utilizing information-theoretic, geometric, and optimization metrics across model scales (1B-32B). Our experiments reveal a distinct depth-dependent pattern: middle layers (20\%-80\%) are stable, whereas final layers exhibit high sensitivity. Leveraging this insight, we propose Mid-Block Efficient Tuning, which selectively updates these critical intermediate layers. Empirically, our method outperforms standard LoRA up to 10.2\% on GSM8K (OLMo2-7B) with reduced parameter overhead, demonstrating that effective alignment is architecturally localized rather than distributed. The code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/base_sft.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.11838v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：尽管监督微调（SFT）对对齐至关重要，但它存在灾难性遗忘的风险，然而指令遵循能力的逐层涌现机制仍然难以捉摸。我们通过利用信息论、几何和优化指标，在模型规模（1B-32B）上进行了全面分析来研究这一机制。我们的实验揭示了明显的深度依赖模式：中层（20%-80%）稳定，而最终层表现出高敏感性。基于这一洞察，我们提出了中块高效调优方法，该方法选择性地更新这些关键中间层。实证上，我们的方法在GSM8K（OLMo2-7B）上比标准LoRA提升了高达10.2%，且参数开销更少，表明有效的对齐是架构局部化的而非分布式的。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/base_sft公开获取。
tldr: 本文通过逐层分析发现监督微调中指令遵循能力主要集中在中层，并提出中块高效调优方法，在减少参数开销的同时显著提升性能，表明对齐能力具有架构局部性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through layer-wise analysis that instruction-following capability during supervised fine-tuning is concentrated in middle layers, and proposes Mid-Block Efficient Tuning which selectively updates these layers, achieving up to 10.2% improvement over LoRA with reduced parameters, demonstrating that alignment is architecturally localized.
